Great Japanese Food and Golf
Jan 2019 • Friends
Yes this place is great for Japanese food and to play a round of golf on a golf simulator. First the restaurant has golf simulators where you can play around of golf and have drinks and food with friends and family while they watch or play. You can chose a course to play and number of players all indoors and with food and drink.

The food is great. Hajime is a great chef. We had the Shabu Shabu with ribeye imported from the USA and fresh seafood.

Perhaps to well hidden
Oct 2018 • Solo
If you walk past this bar you would not know it because it is in the quiet end of the street and you cannot see inside. Do not be fooled this is a great place to hang out it is very clean and features a thick slab timber bar which I loved. There is a good selection of beers and sake, but what got me was the great selection of top shelf scotch. When I arrived I ordered a beer and received a complimentary bowl of nuts Japanese style and what got me was a hot towel - just like a business class flight. I had a dish of mussels and also some beef carpachio which was up there with the best. If you like your beef rare this will hit the spot, I finished off with an excellent whisky. This is one of those places that is most definitely on my come back again list.
